objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level such as code of conduct, travel expenses policy, or ICS policy

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Company-wide or locally defined regulations and instructions for business processes

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Specific procedures within a framework describing process sequence, details, and responsible persons to achieve objectives

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed work steps and special procedures such as test instructions with compliance criteria for sub-processes

objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object in the system with properties, content, and versioning

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document that can be released directly via switches

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal to amend a document created by authors without affecting the content or version history of the original document

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A request created by the system to check and potentially extend the validity period of a document

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it when it has no additional validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document information object with selection of corresponding document type and template

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Editing of document content and properties including metadata maintenance

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Assignment of authorizations and workflow participants in the Control (release) category

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of the 3-step release process by author or co-authors

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks content according to technical and formal aspects

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves and publishes the document to readers

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Author creates a change proposal for an existing document without affecting version history

evts.name: process_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned change proposal

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before document validity expires

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Releaser or author/reviewer/releaser team extends the validity period of a document

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: User with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Releaser or author/reviewer/releaser team declares document invalid and archives it

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Initiator confirms reactivation and document is restored to active status

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Author adds additional information attachment to a document

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Author adds controlled attachment to a document

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translator translates released document content into another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Reviewer checks translated document content

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Releaser approves and publishes translated document version

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: System sends email notifications to users about released document

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: System requests users to actively confirm acknowledgement of released document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of document in workflow

o2o.description: Policy provides strategic framework for guidelines
Guideline defines framework for procedural instructions
Procedural instruction references work instructions for detailed steps
Document has supplementary additional information attachments
Document has controlled attachments subject to same versioning
Change proposal clearly belongs to and is displayed in document
Validity extension request is linked to document to be checked
Override request is created for a selected document
Attachment content affects the version of associated main document

o2e.description: Document object is created in system
Document content and properties are edited
Authorizations are assigned to document
Document is submitted for approval workflow
Document is reviewed for technical and formal aspects
Document is approved and published
Change proposal is created for document
Change proposal editing is documented
Validity extension request is created for document
Validity extension request is processed
Override request is created for document
Override request is processed to invalidate document
Reactivation request is created
Reactivation request is processed
Additional information is added to document
Attachment is added to document
Document content is translated
Translated document is reviewed
Translated document version is released
Document is distributed via email notifications
Acknowledgement is requested for document
Document acknowledgement is confirmed by recipient
Attachment is released with main document
